stories.title: Above average temperatures return soon
stories.summary: Afternoon temps will be in the low 60s, which is seasonable for this time of the year.

stories.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins US Senate race in Alaska, beating incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan
stories.summary: Democrat Mary Peltola has defeated two-term Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan in Alaska.

stories.title: Wake school board approves student enrollment plan by 8-1 vote
stories.summary: The proposal was aimed at addressing school overcrowding and determining attendance areas for the new Morrisville High School.

stories.title: New Hulu doc explores Derek and Hayley Hough's harrowing dance recovery journey
stories.summary: Watch the trailer for "The Symphony of Dance," Hulu's new documentary capturing Derek and Hayley Hough's incredible journey of recovery and resilience.

stories.title: Man gets nearly 30 years in prison for Trump, Biden assassination plot he said was steered from Iran
stories.summary: A man who admitted trying to get a U.S. politician killed — and said Iran's paramilitary Revolutionary Guard drove him to it — was sentenced Tuesday to nearly three decades in prison.

stories.title: White House pulls FDA nominee Heidi Overton after wavering support from Senate Republicans
stories.summary: The White House said Tuesday it has pulled the nomination of Dr. Heidi Overton to lead the Food and Drug Administration amid growing indications she didn't have the votes needed to win Senate confirmation.

stories.title: US officially loses measles elimination status, PAHO says
stories.summary: Measles elimination was first declared in the United States in 2000.

stories.title: NC Rapper Darrin Burnett remembered through his music as his wife faces murder charge
stories.summary: The shooting has left Darin Burnett's family and friends grieving and remembering his music.

stories.title: Measles vaccination rate for kindergarteners falls below threshold in North Carolina
stories.summary: North Carolina's statewide kindergarten vaccination rate has fallen below the level needed for community protection.

stories.title: City's drought bill tops $4 million as Durham buys water to keep taps running in the Bull City
stories.summary: The price tag comes as water levels remain critically low at Lake Michie, one of Durham's primary drinking water sources.

stories.title: Teens voice curfew concerns to Raleigh city leaders, push alternatives to address youth violence
stories.summary: Raleigh city leaders remain undecided on a proposed teen curfew after hearing feedback from young people who overwhelmingly favored alternatives.

stories.title: Cracking open a Richmond tradition: Bagley Pecans
stories.summary: Bagley Pecans has been a Richmond tradition since 1962. Its seasonal opening brings fresh pecans and memories of holidays past.
